Name: (CP) Dark Wood Kitchen
Author: pray3rz
Description:
[color=#f1f1f1]This mod replaces the kitchen of the farmhouse compatible with SDV 1.6.[/color]

[b][u]Install[/u]:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]﻿[/b]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Download and install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿.
[*]﻿Download the latest version of this mod and unzip it, then copy the '[CP] Dark Wood Kitchen' folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods directory.
[*]﻿You're done; run the game using SMAPI!
[/list]
[u][b]Credits[/b]:

[/u]Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/52928861]froststar11[/url] for giving everyone permission to fix and upload his mods.

Thanks to yellog's beautiful furnitures.

The original mod : ﻿﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3572]Yellog's Dark Wood and Cream Furniture Conversion for Custom Furniture

[/u][/b]
